identifier.value: GoLinks® Knowledge Discovery & Link Management Platform

product.name: GoLinks® Knowledge Discovery & Link Management Platform
product.description: A platform that enables users to create and share internal short links (Go Links®) for quick access to company resources and information.

product.name: GoAI Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered assistant that provides fast, accurate answers to internal queries using generative AI technology.

product.name: GoLinks® Mobile Apps
product.description: Mobile applications for iOS and Android that provide access to GoLinks® resources and short links from anywhere.

product.name: GoLinks® API & Webhooks
product.description: APIs and webhooks that allow custom integrations of GoLinks® with other enterprise applications and workflows.

product.name: GoLinks® Analytics and Usage Trends
product.description: Analytics tools that provide insights into personal and workspace GoLinks® usage, including popular and trending links.

identifier.value: GoLinks® Link Types and Management Features

product.name: GoLinks® Link Types and Management Features
product.description: Various types of Go Links® (variable, private, unlisted, multi-links, geo-links, aliases) and organizational features like collections and tags for managing internal links.
